Jesus... Two Doors Are Open And I Can't Hear You. 🚪

Prayer for anyone stuck between two good doors.

she must choose between two job offers in two cities and every voice around her is louder than the peace she is praying for

Jesus: “You're waiting for a voice when I mostly give a pace. Peace is My green light.”

“Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.”
Proverbs 3:5-6 (KJV)

He isn't silent; He's directing.

How do you tell God's yes from your own hurry?

youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for anyone stuck between two good doors.

She: Jesus... two doors are open and I can't hear You. 🚪
She: Two offers, two cities. Everyone has advice. I only want Yours.
She: But what if I pick wrong and lose what both doors are offering?
Jesus: You're waiting for a voice when I mostly give a pace. Peace is My green light.
Jesus: A step taken with Me can be corrected. A step avoided can't. Walk toward peace.
Jesus: Acknowledge Me in this decision today. I'm not silent; I'm directing.
How do you tell God's yes from your own hurry?
